intro: Every photograph below is our own crew's work on a real Luzerne County property — no catalogue shots, no renderings passed off as finished builds. What you cannot see in any of them is the part that decides whether they last: the excavation depth, the sub-base compacted in lifts, the pitch built in so water leaves instead of sitting, the drainage behind every wall. That work adds days to a schedule and never appears in a photo, which is exactly why it is the first thing a cheaper bid quietly removes. Look at the grade changes, the stair runs, the way the planting and lighting were laid out with the hardscape rather than after it. That is the part we would like you to judge us on.
